thread:
sam: New ask from VectorGrid (HW + SI)  they want a short technical demo + a marketplace "edge bundle" tile. Flow: LangChain orchestration -> LlamaIndex retrieval -> our gateway -> Dedicated. Can we scope owners and minimal risks?

lina: I can own the LangChain/LlamaIndex side. Will run notebook smoke tests and check vector-store tenancy. ETA: Mon EOD.

omar: Ill own the gateway adapter and OrchX/OrchY plugin surface. Quick note: streaming + tool-calls need a small gating change in gateway config. Recommend a staged push in a 1-hr maintenance window.

tia: Marketing/legal: co-announcement needs a signed addendum. Legal-bot, please kick off review. Also want a one-slide cost/latency comparison for the marketplace tile.

legal-bot: Created COANN-3477 for VectorGrid co-announcement review. Typical turnaround 48h.

lina: Found one minor risk: LlamaIndex vector keys might collide across tenants when OrchY runs concurrent ingestion. Proposed quick fix to namespace keys: ```python
# namespace keys per tenant
def lindex_key(tenant_id, doc_hash):
    return f"vg:{tenant_id}:lindex:{doc_hash}"
```

omar: Good. Ill add a toggle in the gateway config for namespacing and plan the maintenance window: Tue 02:00-03:00 UTC to push and smoke test. Rollback plan: revert config and re-route to fallback model if errors >1% in 5m.

tia: Timeline proposal: Mon smoke tests, Tue gateway push + dry-run, Wed internal 09:00 dry-run, Wed 13:00 partner demo. If legal not signed, we keep materials embargoed.

sam: Action items: Lina -> smoke tests & namespacing patch; Omar -> gateway config + maintenance/rollback; Tia -> co-marketing draft & slide with cost numbers; Sam -> coordinate VectorGrid sign-off. Ill post final schedule once legal ACKs. :white_check_mark:
